name: P’u Sung-ling
bio: P’u Sung-ling was a writer of the early Ch’ing dynasty, best known for his collection of tales, Strange Stories from a Chinese Studio.
The poems here are Herbert A. Giles’s versions in Chinese Poetry in English Verse (1898), given with the poet’s name as spelled in that book.

poems.title: Inward Light
poems.author: P’u Sung-ling
poems.text:
With wine and flowers we chase the hours,
In one eternal spring;
No moon, no light, to cheer the night,
Thyself that ray must bring.
